notes: politicalPower, treasury ($), manpower, commandPower: starting stocks. atWar: polities at war with on the start date.
baseWeariness = min(3, daysAtWar / 720) + 400 * cumulativeDeaths / population, times wearinessModifier.
Per battle: weariness += baseWeariness * (100 * deaths / population) * ground; ground 1.0 on own ground, 2.5 elsewhere.
cumulativeDeaths counts civilians and soldiers. wearinessModifier: product of every modifier on the polity.
